name: dsh-stock
description: Read-only market queries for DeepSeek Harness: thirteen Host tools (stock_search, stock_quote, stock_kline, stock_minute, stock_bars, stock_minute_history, stock_moneyflow, stock_fundamentals, stock_market, stock_rank, stock_news, stock_macro, stock_watchlist) over public Tencent and East Money endpoints, plus a persistent watchlist with holding marks and an index row managed from a sidebar panel, with request serialization, per-host backoff, and bounded responses.

scripts.test:
node tests/verify-watchlist.mjs && node tests/verify-endpoints.mjs && node tests/verify-cards.mjs && node ../verify-client-datetime.mjs &&
    node ../verify-client-locales.mjs stock
